Container.Name: igab-aio
Container.Overview: IGAB (I've Got A Budget) All-in-One — self-hosted envelope-budgeting in a single container. Includes PostgreSQL, API, web UI, and automatic backups. No external database required. Perfect for home servers. See https://github.com/brentonmallen1/IGAB for documentation.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: REQUIRED - JWT signing secret; the app refuses to start without a strong value. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Admin Email
Config.Description: Login email for the admin user, created on first run.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: REQUIRED - initial admin password; the app refuses to start on a default/empty value.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: All application data: database, attachments, and backups. Use a single folder for simplicity.

Config.Name: Ollama Host
Config.Description: Optional - URL of an Ollama server for AI receipt scanning / natural-language entry (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434). Also configurable in-app under Settings.

Config.Name: Ollama Model
Config.Description: Default Ollama model for text tasks. Can be changed in-app.

Config.Name: Ollama Vision Model
Config.Description: Optional - separate Ollama model for receipt scanning. Uses the default model if not set.

Config.Name: SimpleFIN Encryption Key
Config.Description: Required to connect a bank with SimpleFIN. Leave blank if you do not use bank sync. This is not a SimpleFIN token: you generate it here, it never leaves this server, and it encrypts the bank credentials IGAB stores. Generate with: python3 -c 'from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())' (a hex string from openssl rand -hex 32 will not work). Keep a copy: connections saved with this key cannot be read with any other.

Config.Name: Backup Interval (hours)
Config.Description: Hours between automatic backups. Default: 24 (daily).

Config.Name: Backup Retention (days)
Config.Description: Delete backups older than this many days.

Config.Name: Minimum Backups to Keep
Config.Description: Always keep at least this many backups, regardless of age.

Config.Name: Backup Encryption Key
Config.Description: Optional - age public key for encrypting backups. Generate keypair with: age-keygen

Config.Name: SMTP Host
Config.Description: Optional - SMTP server for email notifications.

Config.Name: SMTP Port
Config.Description: SMTP server port.

Config.Name: SMTP Username
Config.Description: SMTP authentication username.

Config.Name: SMTP Password
Config.Description: SMTP authentication password.

Config.Name: SMTP TLS
Config.Description: Use TLS for SMTP connection.

Config.Name: SMTP From Address
Config.Description: From address for notification emails.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone for scheduled tasks.
